data.title: Government of Canada announces reconstruction of wharf 401 at Petit-de-Grat Small Craft Harbour
data.author: Fisheries and Oceans Canada
data.summary: Small craft harbours are vital infrastructure for coastal and rural communities, supporting fishing, transportation, and the local economies built around them. Billions of dollars in fish and seafood are landed at these harbours every year. Canada’s commercial fisheries, aquaculture, and seafood processing sectors support nearly 65,000 jobs, including more than 42,900 commercial fish harvesters from coast to coast to coast. In 2025, Canada’s fish and seafood exports totaled $8.47 billion.
